Decision clock: decisions evaluated on completed daily bars = the H1 snapshot bar whose OPEN instant maps to 16:00 America/New_York wall time via zoneinfo (20:00Z EDT weeks, 21:00Z EST weeks); decision_ts recorded = that open instant. Provider Sunday 16:00-NY bars sit before the frozen Sun 21:00-NY weekly open and are EXCLUDED from the daily series (observed 172 such bars/pair in the real snapshot), so Friday decisions fill Monday, never a closed Sunday bar. Warmup: first 63 daily bars per pair void (anchor/control); neighbour needs 252 eligible reads (voids until bar 251).

Fills: entry/exit at the OPEN of the NEXT EXISTING 16:00-NY bar (one-event lag); next bar missing => skipped_decision / skipped_exit recorded in meta, never fill-forward; fill lag beyond the runner's frozen 4-day allowance => skipped, keeping the stream inside ONE_EVENT_LAG_VIOLATION bounds. Exit law: hold while the arm state persists; state cease (flip/0/void) => exit next existing bar; fold boundaries 2022-05-01/2024-07-01 force-flat: open positions close AT the last existing pre-boundary bar's open with force_flat=true, and entry decisions on that bar and the one before are suppressed (they would fill at or immediately before the forced flatten). A position still open at data end cannot book an exit and is dropped with a counter (fail-closed).

Macro: policy rates read ONLY via macro_reader.policy_rate/differential (availability-gated available_time_utc <= decision instant; missing vintage files/areas raise MacroDataBlocked BLOCKED_DATA; None = NO_EVAL => bar void, never backfilled). Pair->areas frozen: EUR/USD(EMU,US), GBP/USD(GB,US), AUD/USD(AU,US), NZD/USD(NZ,US), USD/JPY(US,JP), USD/CHF(US,CH), USD/CAD(US,CA). Vintages are percent-per-annum (BIS adapter unit); converted to annualized decimals by /100 at one defined point. data_paths keys consumed: price_h1_dir (directory directly containing <TAG>_1h_*_a.json TwelveData windows, td_loader schema, error-status windows skipped, dedupe on stamp, OHLC quarantine with 0.1% fail-closed ceiling) and macro_vintages (only when macro_reader is None). freeze_token accepted and ignored.

Financing events: one per decision, formula id V3_FROZEN_POLICY_RATE_CARRY; adjustment = round(sign * notional_usd * fsum(day-start differentials) / 365, 10) accrued per calendar day at that day's 00:00Z as-of differential over the held calendar days (entry < day-start <= exit); a non-evaluable day-start read fails closed (RuntimeError BLOCKED_DATA) - unreachable after an eligible entry decision by monotone availability. Disclosed approximation carried in meta.financing_disclosure: policy rates are unsecured official rates, NOT swap/OIS-implied rollover.

Determinism: no wall-clock reads, sorted iterations, fixed float order, rounding ONLY at the financing round-10 point; decisions sorted by (decision_ts, pair); decision_id = f'{arm_id}|{pair}|{decision_ts_iso}'. Tests assert run_arm twice returns identical output for all three arms.
